symptom: `report performance` shows random steps several seconds slower than they are: on ako/PizzaV1 'place order and pay' read 4,884 ms of server time while its own requests took 280 ms
cause: spansIn gave a step every span that started inside its time window, so a queued task (the simulator's 1.5 s clock tick), scheduled events and the task queue's polling counted as the step's server time, database time and queries
insight: Attribute by trace, not by time: a step owns the traces rooted in an HTTP request to the app port (the most common server.port among http roots) that start in its window; other roots are background, measured apart. With that, db time matched the project's own analysis on all 12 steps. Keep the window rule only as a labelled fallback for collectors without http attributes
